name: LiteRT (TFLite successor) GitHub Repository
notes:
LiteRT is the successor to TensorFlow Lite, announced 2025. Maintains .tflite model format. Supports Android (NNAPI, GPU delegate), iOS (CoreML, Metal), and embedded Linux. Focused on on-device ML with smaller binary footprint than TFLite.
